sheet.name: Knight of the Fen

traits.name: One with the Swamp
traits.text: Dwell: Move the Monster miniature to the closest unoccupied space on a Swamp Terrain tile.

traits.name: We Are Many
traits.text: Whenever the Knight of the Fen is dealt a Wound, (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds) place a Generic token on this Trait. After you finish resolving the current action, if there are 4 or more Generic tokens on this Trait, discard all Generic tokens, Spawn a Doppelknight on the closest Swamp Terrain tile that doesn’t have a Doppelknight on it, and perform Signature.

traits.name: Doppelknight
traits.text:
Start of Clash: Spawn a Doppelknight on a Swamp Terrain tile closest to Knight of the Fen.

When Spawning a Doppelknight, place its token on the designated space in a Mob base ring with the lowest available number. Then, take the top card of the BP deck and place it face down on the leftmost empty space on the Mob track—this is the Doppelknight’s BP card.

Doppelknights are Mobs without Activation tokens (they can still activate, see the Doppelganger Trait). They have Advanced Bypass, Odd Spawn, and the same To Hit [To Hit] value as Knight of the Fen. After wounding a Doppelknight BP, place it on the Wound Stack, remove the Doppelknight token, and place a 1x2 Swamp Terrain tile on its space. Escalate as if you dealt a Wound to Knight of the Fen. When a Knight is involuntarily moved onto a Doppelknight token, they are Displaced and gain the Slimed Condition card.

If at any point there are no cards in the BP deck and discard pile, you immediately lose the Clash!

traits.name: Ooze Trap
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Place the Engulfed Trait card near the Monster Sheet.
When Knight of the Fen or Doppelknight moves through a space with a Knight on it, that Knight doesn’t suffer Crash, but gains the Slimed Condition card instead.

Level 2–3: They additionally lose -2 [Vigor].
When Knight of the Fen ends its movement on a Knight, that Knight becomes Engulfed (place your miniature on Engulfed Trait card and gain the Slimed Condition card).

traits.name: Doppelganger
traits.text: All Doppelknights activate after Knight of the Fen, starting from the lowest number on the Mob track, and perform Attacks using the Doppelganger effect on the drawn AI card (if there’s any), using the same Evasion stats. If a Doppelknight doesn’t have a valid Target during its Activation, skip its Attack. If there’s a Chain Break during Knight of the Fen’s or Doppelknight’s Activation, do not activate any more Doppelknights during that Monster Round.

traits.name: Spread Thin
traits.text: Every Doppelknight on the Clash Board lowers Knight of the Fen’s [AT] by 1, to a minimum of 1.

traits.name: Living Wasteheap
traits.text:
All Knights gain “Crit Miss: Discard a chosen Gear [Gear] card and place it on the Living Wasteheap Trait.”
The Knight of the Fen gains the following benefits depending on the Gear [Gear] cards on this Trait:
For every Weapon: Knight of the Fen’s Attacks additionally cause -1 [Vigor] loss.
Whenever Armor is placed: Place 2 Armor [Armor] tokens on the Sheet.
For every Support: Knight of the Fen gains +1 [To Hit].

traits.name: Absorb the Fallen
traits.text: When a Doppelknight dies, place an Armor [Armor] token on the Monster Sheet.

traits.name: Concentrated Strength
traits.text:
When spawning a Doppelknight, resolve it as normal, except take the top 2 BP cards instead of 1, and place them in a face down stack on the leftmost empty space on the Mob track. If you cannot (i.e. when there’s only 1 card left in the BP deck), you lose the Clash!
When you would reveal a Doppelknight BP, reveal both of its BP cards (keep them in the same order).
When attacking a Doppelknight, if your Total Power exceeds the summed [AT] of both BPs, you Wound both cards and resolve the Critical Response. Otherwise, you fail to wound either card, and must resolve the Fail or Instinct Response. Resolve all Attack Responses, as well as Overcome or Overpower effects only from the top BP card in the stack. Always Escalate the top wounded BP first.

traits.name: We Are Legion
traits.text:
Disable the Spread Thin Trait.

Start of Clash: Spawn an additional Doppelknight on a Swamp Terrain tile closest to Knight of the Fen.

traits.name: Inescapable Slime
traits.text:
Disable the Ooze Trap Trait.
When Knight of the Fen moves through a Knight, that Knight doesn’t suffer Crash and becomes Engulfed instead.
When a Doppelknight moves through a Knight, that Knight gains the Slimed Condition card and loses -2 [Vigor].
